Hearing these words, King Dasaratha, became dejected and

brief.summary_1line: Parasurama confronts Rama after the bow-breaking, challenging him to string and fire another divine bow and prove his strength.

image_candidates.scene_text: Parasurama stands sternly before Rama holding the massive bow of Yamadagni while the anxious King Dasaratha pleads beside his son.
Parasurama presents the terrible bow forged by Vishwakarma, challenging Rama to string it as courtiers and sages watch in tense silence.
